title: lore weaponry
description: a very simple mod that extra weapons and items for oriate to help enhance the lore immersion within the server!
body:
A very plain and simple mod that adds a handful of weapons and items for the oriate 
smp.

This mod features custom weapons (ex. the legendary shulk sword, or the brutish claws!), and soon to be plushes and other goodies for the server members to enjoy!

All the items can currently be obtained via crafting them with vanilla items.

Recipes can be viewed with the help of JEI or minecraft's built in recipe book.

All the models are made in house!

Currently exclusive to the fabric mod loader and I highly doubt it will ever be ported to forge.

To the members of the server, get your hands on a model or whatever
so that it can be added to the mod

I suck at modeling, I am not the one to ask to fulfill these requests :^)
